description: [Kyreos, 1 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Send a list of MCP server URLs. Each one is probed live and classified as up, auth (needs credentials), broken, or down, with its name, URL and host. You also get totals per state and a checked timestamp. For registries and directories that list MCP servers and need to prune dead entries. Input: {"urls":["https://mcp.example.com/mcp", "..."]}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/mcp-liveness-probe?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (1 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result. The HTTP route also gives 3 free calls a day per caller.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (1 USDC on Base)
